hypotheses.binder: (hι : ∃ ι : L →+* ℂ, ι ζ = Complex.exp (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I / q))
hypotheses.justification: No other binder and not the conclusion mentions hι, and the proof never refers to it. The proof's steps all use other named hypotheses: `fix` uses hq, hqM', hA', hO, hOW and comap_levelAutBar_eq_of_redQ_smul_lineInfty_eq; the converse uses hτ, hIT, hφ, hε, levelAutBar_mul, coe_levelAutBar_apply_eq_qExpand_sq_of_dvd_of_mem_laurentBaseChange_gamma0 and comap_gauss_ne_of_coe_apply_eq_qExpand_sq_jqModC with hAq, hW₀, hιK. All of these receive their arguments explicitly, and the only automation (`simp [βM, ...]`, `push_cast`, `rwa`) does not pick up arbitrary local hypotheses. So the same proof works after deleting hι.

No other binder and not the conclusion mentions hζ; ζ itself is still used in hτ and hIT. The proof never refers to hζ: the lemmas it applies take their arguments explicitly and none of them is given hζ. So the proof works unchanged without it.

hypotheses.binder: (hζA : ∃ x : A, algebraMap A L x = ζ)
hypotheses.justification: No other binder and not the conclusion mentions hζA. The proof never uses it: the only facts about A it uses are hAq and hW₀, both passed to comap_gauss_ne_of_coe_apply_eq_qExpand_sq_jqModC, whose signature (q, L, K, A, hAq, W₀, hW₀, φ, j, hj, hφj) does not include it. So the proof works unchanged without it.

No other binder and not the conclusion mentions hζ'. ζ' is only used as an explicit argument to levelAutBar and its lemmas (comap_levelAutBar_eq_of_redQ_smul_lineInfty_eq, levelAutBar_mul, coe_levelAutBar_apply_eq_qExpand_sq_of_dvd_of_mem_laurentBaseChange_gamma0), and the proof never passes or uses hζ'. The link between ζ' and the automorphisms of K is supplied entirely by hIT and hφ. So the proof works unchanged without it.

The statement elaborates without it: IsLevelAutAt needs only [Field L] [CharZero L], and laurentBaseChange/coeffEmb need only [Field L] [Algebra ℚ L], which comes from CharZero. The proof does not need it either. I read the signatures of the lemmas it uses over L, and none of them takes an IsAlgebraic instance: comap_gauss_ne_of_coe_apply_eq_qExpand_sq_jqModC, coeffEmb_mem_laurentBaseChange, map_jqModC (any ring hom) and StabElem.coeffMap_injective (any injective ring hom). The remaining lemmas (levelAutBar_*) are stated over AlgebraicClosure ℚ, not L. So the proof works unchanged after the instance is deleted.
